content: Betesda foiror ḍake aram gora
Iyar bade Ihudi okkolor ek id oiye, ar Isa uwore Zeruzalem giye.
Ar heṛe Zeruzalemot Sool Geiṭor hãse ugguwa foir ase, zibare Ibroni bašat Betesda ho, ar hibat fãssan saniola gãṭ aššil.
In okkolot ek dõr biyaraimma mainšor dol foritakito, zara anda, lula, ãtur manuš okkol.
(Kiyollahoile ek firistaye šome šome oi foirot lami zaiyore fani hafaito, ei fani hafa bade ze foila fanit lamito, hitattu ze hono ḍoilla biyaram takibo takok, aram oi zaitogoi.)
Ar heṛe ekzon manuš aššil, ze tiriš ašṭo bosormula biyaraimma,
hite heṛe fori taikkede Isaye deikke, ar zani faijje ze hite bout din dori hite he abostat ase, toi hibaye hitare fusar goredde:

content.text: "Tui aram oito sos ne?"

content: He biyaraimma manušwaye hodde, "Malik, fani hafi uṛede šomot ãre foirot lamai loizaoya ãttu hono kiye nai; ar ãi nize zaite zaite ar ekzon ãr agottu lamegoi."
Toi Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Uṭ, tor bisana tuli lo edde aṭ."

content: Hehon he manušwa aram oiye; ar hite hitar bisanagan tuli loiye edde ãiṭṭe. Ar he din aššilde Šabbat,
Ihudi neta okkole aram gora oiyede he manušware hodde, "Aijja, Šabbat, ain mozin bisana boi loi za mana."
Hite hitarare zuwab diye, "Hiba ze ãre aram goijje, hibaye ãre hoiye,

content.text: 'Tor bisana tuli lo edde aṭ.'

content: Toi hitara hitattu fusar goijje, "Manuš hiba honnuwa ze tore bisana tuli lo edde aṭ hoiye?"
Ze manušwa aram oiye hite no zanito hiba honnuwa aššil, kiyollahoile Isaye šori gilgoi, heṛe beša beši manuš okkol aššil.
Fore zaiyore Isaye he manušware abar dórmogóror uṛanot lot faiye edde hitare hodde:

content.text: "Sa, tui bala oiyos, guna ar no goris, toi zene tor uwore iyattuwaro aro horaf hono kissu no goṭe."

content: Hite zaiyore Ihudi netare hoiyegoi ze, hitare bala goijje hiba aššilde Isa.
Futor odihar
Ar iyanolla boli Ihudi okkole hibare zala šuru goijje, kiyollahoile hibaye in okkol Šabbatot goijje.
Ar Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãr Baf ehon foijjonto hamot, ar ãi o ham gorir."

content: Iyanor zoriya Ihudi okkole hibare marifelaibolla aro beši kušiš goijje; kiyollahoile hibaye šude Šabbator niyom no bange, kintu Allare hibaye nizor Baf o hoiye, hiba nizore Allar fuwainna goriyore.
Iyanot Isaye hitarare zuwab diye edde hodde:

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, Fute nizottu hono kissu gori no fare; zodi hibar Bafe kissu gorede no deke; kiyollahoile zin hibaye gore Fute o gore.
Kiyollahoile Bafe Futore ador gore, ar hár kissu zin hibaye nize gore, beggun hibare deha; ar inottuwaro aro mohan ham okkol hibaye hibare dehaibo, zene tũwara ammuwak o.
Zendilla Bafe mora okkolore tule edde zibon de, hendilla Fute o hibattu zare issa hitare zibon de.
Aro, Bafe honokiyor bisar no gore, kintu bisaror fura bar hibar Futor uwore diye,
zene beggune Bafore šorman gorede mozin Futore šorman gore; hite ze Futore šorman no gore, hite Bafore šorman no gore, ze hibare defeṛaiye.
"Soiyi, soiyi, ãi tũwarare hoir, hite ze ãr kalam funer, ar ze ãre faṭaiye hibare biššaš gorer, hitattu akeri zibon ase; ar hitare bisarot tula no oibo, kintu morattu zibonot faraiyegoi.
Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, en ṭaim aiyer, bolke hiyan ehon aišše, zẽtte mora okkole Allar Futor abaz funibo, edde hitara zara funibo, hitara basibo.
Kiyollahoile Baf nizottu zendilla zibon ase, hendilla hibaye Fut nizottu o zibon taibolla diye.
Ar hibaye hibare bisar goribolla odihar diye, kiyollahoile hiba oilde Adomor Fut.
"Ei hota funi ammuwak no oiyo, kiyollahoile en ṭaim aiyer, zara hoborot ase hitara beggune hibar abaz funibo,
edde hitara niyoli aibo, hitara zara bala ham goijje hitara zibon faibolla, ar hitara zara horaf ham goijje, hitara šasti faibolla.
Ãi nizottu kissu gori no fari, zendilla funi hendilla bisar gori, ãr bisar niyaiwala, kiyollahoile ãi ãttu ziyan goitto mone hor, hen no sai, kintu hibaye zendilla sar, ze ãre defeṛaiye.

content: Isar babute goba

content.text: "Ãi nize zodi ãr babute goba di, ãr goba soiyi no.
Kintu ar ekzon ase ze ãr babute goba der, ar ãi zani ze hibaye ãr babute ze goba der hiyan soiyi.
"Tũwara Yahyar hãse manuš defeṛaila, ar hibaye soiyir foikka goba diye.
Manuše ãr gobar dok ãi hiyan saide no; kintu ãi iyan hoir zene tũwara uddar fo.
Yahya aššil he zoledde edde ujjol serag, ar tũwara hibar he fohorot hoto dinolla anondo goribolla issa goijjila.
"Kintu ãttu Yahyar gobattuwaro aro mohan goba ase, kiyollahoile Bafe ãre ze ham okkol gori šeš goribolla diye, ze ham okkol ãi gorir, in okkole ãr babute endilla goba der ze ãre Bafe defeṛaiye.
Ar Baf, ze ãre defeṛaiye, hibaye nize ãr babute goba diye. Tũwara honodin hibar abaz no funo, hibar rohom o no deko.
Ar tũwarar dilot hibar kalam o bošoti no gorer, kiyollahoile hibaye defeṛaiyede hibare tũwara biššaš no goro.
Tũwara pak kitabor kalam tuwo, kiyollahoile akeri zibon heṛe butore faiba boli mone goro. Kintu ei pak kitabor kalam okkol oilde hin zine ãr babute goba de,
tarfore o tũwara zibon faibolla ãr hase aito issa no goro.
"Ãi manušor hãsottu tarif no gosi,
kintu ãi tũwarare sini, tũwarar dilot Allar ador nai.
Ãi ãr Bafor namot aišši, ar tũwara ãre no gosor; kintu oinno kiye zodi hitar nizor name aiye, hitare tũwara gosiba.
Tũwara kengori biššaš gori faro? Tũwara ekzone ar ekzonottu tarif goso, kintu ze tarif šude Allar torfottu aiye hiyan no tuwo.
"Mone no goijjo ze, tũwarare ãi Bafor sarme duši banaiyum; kintu tũwarar duši goroya oilde Musa, zar uwore tũwarar aša raikko.
Kiyollahoile tũwara zodi Musare biššaš gorita, toile tũwara ãre biššaš gorita, kiyollahoile hibaye ãre babute leikke.
Kintu tũwara zodi hibar leka biššaš no goro, toile ãi hoidde hin kengori biššaš goriba?"
